## Circular to Licensed Corporations which are licensed for Type 6 regulated activity

## Theme Inspection of Sponsors

1. The SFC plans to conduct a theme inspection on sponsors licensed by the SFC after the first quarter of 2005.
2. Sponsors are a type of corporate finance advisers subject to the SFC Corporate Finance Adviser Code of Conduct (SFC Code).  The SFC code imposes upon a corporate finance adviser, among other things, a duty to exercise due care and skill  and  to  keep  books  and  records  in  relation  to  the  advisory  work  it  has undertaken.    More  specifically,  corporate  finance  advisers  that  engage  in corporate  finance  advisory  work  under  the  Listing  Rules  are  required  by  the SFC Code to observe the specific requirements under the Listing Rules.
3. In  a  joint  press  release  of  the  SFC  and  SEHK  on  19  October  2004,  SEHK announced  amendments  to  the  Listing  Rules  relating  to  the  regulation  of sponsors  and  independent  financial  advisers.      The  rule  amendments 1 make clear, among other things, the role and responsibilities of sponsors, including the  due  diligence  SEHK  expects  the  sponsors  to  typically  perform  on  new applicants for listing.  Sponsors are urged to put in place effective systems and procedures to ensure compliance with the rule amendments which will come into effect on 1 January 2005.
4. The  SFC,  as  the  statutory  regulator  of  sponsors  licensed  with  the  SFC,  will perform a theme inspection on sponsors to review their compliance with the SFC Code, with particular reference to the due diligence practice note 2 recently issued by the SEHK.
5. In  an  IPO  process,  sponsors  play  the  role  of  a  gate-keeper.    They  have  the overriding duty to conduct proper due diligence. The  SFC  will  take disciplinary actions against the sponsors who fail in their duties.   Penalties of an SFC  disciplinary action include  imposition of fines,  suspension  and revocation of license.

Our Ref:  SFO/IS/028/2004

The rule amendments are available on HKEx's website at: http://www.hkex.com.hk/rule/mbrule/mb\_ruleupdate.htm (Main Board rules)(English version); and http://www.hkex.com.hk/rule/gemrule/gemrule\_update.htm (GEM rules)(English version).

- 2: The  due  diligence  practice  note,  Due  diligence  by  sponsors  in  respect  of initial  listing  applications,  is  part  of  the  rule  amendments  announced  by SEHK  on  19  October 2004. It provides guidance as to  SEHK's expectations of the due diligence steps sponsors will typically perform.
